body.cost_method: average cost (holdings); FIFO parcels for tax
body.note:
The consolidator of Australian car retail, now exporting the model to Canada at higher margins. 

A share-taker: record 15.9% new-car share and a widening margin gap to the industry. 

Canada is accretive, at a 4.2% return on sales against 3.0% in ANZ, with only 2.5% Canadian share and a full-half contribution from 2H26. 

The proposed 50% Zagame JV (prestige brands, about A$600m revenue) adds another growth leg.
